records.title: Early pregnancy loss
records.abstract: ABSTRACT: Previously called spontaneous abortion, early pregnancy loss (EPL) is the preferred term encompassing threatened abortion, incomplete abortion, complete abortion, and anembryonic pregnancy. EPL has many causes, including chromosomal abnormalities, immunologic and infectious causes, and underlying maternal risk factors. Because many patients present with first-trimester bleeding, clinicians must know the appropriate evaluation and management techniques.

records.title: The relationship between fetal wastage and pregnancy spacing in Bangladesh
records.abstract: The relationship between early fetal wastage or stillbirth and pregnancy spacing was examined in a population characterized by prolonged lactation, minimal nutrition, and high fertility and mortality. Lactation as a possible causal factor is discussed.
